name: Grants Advantage
description: Gives the target advantage on a specific roll type — attack rolls, saving throws, or a described combination — rather than a flat bonus.

mechanics.text: While active, the target rolls twice and takes the higher result on featureParams.rollType. Distinct from feat.skill-bonus (a specific skill/ability check, tiered advantage/+2/+5) and feat.modifies-roll (a fixed numeric or bonus-die modifier, not advantage).
